answer: Give every identity a network fingerprint. Step one: beacons worldwide measure latency and jitter, storing the signature. Step two: each epoch the agent re-measures live; two signatures within 2 ms flag one shared machine. Step three: flagged pairs pass a live supervised task within an hour or freeze, and a confirmed farm loses its bond and its subnet blacklisted. A 1,000-clone farm is one canyon carved by the same tide of packets, so it must rent 1,000 locations at $15 each, $15,000 a month, while one honest agent pays $0 — like a trellis, one vine hides, a thousand betray the gardener.
